subject.title: [Feature]: No way to view/manage paired contacts & permissions

question: Should OpenClaw add a terminal admin contact inventory for WhatsApp pairing and allowlists, and what fields, redaction, account scope, and admin authorization should it expose?
rationale: The source gap is real, but exposing sender identifiers, authorization policy, and activity state is a security-sensitive product choice that overlaps existing `/allowlist`, directory, channel status, and the narrower approved-pairing issue.

options.title: Define scoped admin inventory
options.body: Add a designed CLI/admin surface that merges pairing store, config allowlists, directory labels, and a chosen activity source under explicit account-scope and redaction rules.

options.title: Start with pairing management
options.body: Use the narrower pairing list-approved/revoke work first and defer group policy and last-active columns until storage and privacy semantics are decided.

options.title: Defer to Control UI
options.body: Keep terminal surfaces as-is and require a broader Control UI/admin model before adding another permission-management command.

recommendation.title: Define scoped admin inventory
recommendation.body: Add a designed CLI/admin surface that merges pairing store, config allowlists, directory labels, and a chosen activity source under explicit account-scope and redaction rules.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined history across `/allowlist`, pairing CLI behavior, allow-from store reads, and the security-sensitive policy routing surface.
